name: repo-hygiene
description: Evidence-led Git hygiene with routine review, explicit deep audits, and user-approved execution.

interface.shortDescription: Evidence-led routine and deep Git hygiene.
interface.longDescription: A three-skill Git hygiene plugin that turns repository evidence into a plain-language audit report and numbered recommendations. Routine local housekeeping can be selected automatically; topology, recovery, integration, object-store, and regression analysis require explicit invocation. No cleanup, pruning, integration, rewrite, remote mutation, or bisection proceeds until the user approves specific recommendation IDs.
capabilities: Explicit topology, integration, and recovery audits
Explicit regression, attribution, and code-search audits
defaultPrompt: Use $repo-hygiene:routine to audit this checkout and present cleanup recommendations for my approval.
Use $repo-hygiene:deep to audit repository topology and present integration or recovery recommendations for my approval.
Use $repo-hygiene:debug to investigate this reproducible regression and present findings for my approval.
